scope: Proposition 4.1 (Bounded moduli denominator) of the manuscript “Uniform Pluricanonical Iitaka Fibrations” (preprints/Uniform-Pluricanonical-Iitaka-Fibrations-October-3-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 034 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 88c226e29ee72119), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 11. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There are positive integers p0 | p, depending only on n, with the following property. Let f : X → Z be a contraction of normal projective complex varieties, where dim X = n, dim Z > 0, X is klt, and KX is rationally linearly equivalent to the pullback of a rational Cartier divisor on Z. Then there are a rational function ψ ∈ C(X)∗ and canonical bundle formula data satisfying the equality of rational divisors KX + 1 p0 div(ψ) = f∗ DZ, DZ = KZ + BZ + MZ. (4.1) Here BZ ≥ 0 has coefficients in a rational DCC set depending only on n, the generalized pair (Z, BZ + MZ) is generalized klt, and the moduli b-divisor M is b-nef with pM b-Cartier.
